description: A skin condition characterized by focal peeling of the palms and less often the soles.
symptoms: Peeling can leave tender, erythematous, circular or oval areas.
Affected skin may become dry and cracked.
causes: The cause is unknown; cleavage occurs within the outer horny layer of the skin.
risk_factors: Exposure to irritants such as water, soap, detergents and solvents may aggravate symptoms.
It may be more common with sweaty palms.

appearance.general: Focal superficial peeling of the palms, sometimes the soles, with collarettes of scale after superficial blisters rupture.

general_first_aid: Use an appropriate emollient hand cream.
prevention: Reduce exposure to soaps, detergents, solvents and other identified irritants.
doctor_discussion_points: Whether fungal infection or contact dermatitis needs to be excluded if the presentation is atypical.

sources.title: Keratolysis exfoliativa (keratolysis exfoliativa, focal palmar peeling)
